environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) with route table containing only local VPC routes and no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoints for internet-routable services, and no peering connections to internet-connected VPCs. The only ingress path is via an internal NLB (scheme: internal) with listener on port 8080 forwarding to the ECS target group. The NLB's security posture means only RFC1918 sources within the VPC can reach it. DNS resolution for the service endpoint resolves to a private IP only within the VPC's Route53 private hosted zone. There is no public DNS record. The subnet's network ACL has explicit DENY on all egress to 0.0.0.0/0 and explicit DENY on all ingress from non-RFC1918 sources.

config.vpc_subnet: private 10.0.128.0/20, route table: local only (no 0.0.0.0/0 route)
config.vpc_endpoints: only com.amazonaws.region.ecr.dkr, com.amazonaws.region.ecr.api, com.amazonaws.region.logs (interface endpoints, no S3 gateway)
config.load_balancer: internal NLB, scheme: internal, listener TCP:8080
config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone only, no public record
config.network_acl: inbound ALLOW 10.0.0.0/8 all ports, inbound DENY 0.0.0.0/0; outbound ALLOW 10.0.0.0/8 all ports, outbound DENY 0.0.0.0/0
config.security_group_ecs: inbound from NLB SG only on 8080
